id1.description: Details of use, administration, dispensing or other care step relating to a medicine, vaccine or other therapeutic good which may arise from an instruction from a clinician.

id3.description: The instruction has issued as an item on a prescription.

id5.description: The medication has been taken by, or administered to, the patient for the first time.

id7.description: A single administration of the medication has taken place.

id8.description: The medication course has been completed as planned.

id9.description: The medication course has not been dispensed as supply is not yet available.

id10.description: The administration of the medication has been suspended. No further doses should be given until further notice, or when the restart date or conditions have been met.

id11.description: A prescription token has been re-issued for an existing medication order.

id12.description: Reissuing of this prescription is not available without some intervention.

id13.description: The planned administration has been cancelled prior to any administration.

id14.description: A scheduled medication has been postponed prior to any administration.

id16.description: The administration of this medication has been ceased before anticipated completion.

id17.description: The time to start this medication, or other starting condition, has been set.

id19.description: The administration of a medication has been withheld and not given. There is no expectation that it will be given later, though the next dose (if any) should be administered according to the original order.

id21.description: The medicine, vaccine or other therapeutic good which was the focus of the action. This element will normally be coded with a medicines terminology but free text may be required in some cases.

id22.description: The reason(s) the specific action or step was carried out. Note: This is not the reason for the medication instruction, rather the specific reason e.g. for administration.

id25.description: A comment on the action taken including details of any variance between the intended action and the action actually performed.

id26.description: The sequence number specific to the action being recorded.

id34.description: Any guidance, instructions or advice given to the subject of care or carer at the time of the action.

id36.description: A dispensed medication is returned, or not collected, without being used.

id40.description: A major change to the order was required, resulting in this order being stopped and a replacement order being started.

id42.description: The medication order has been changed in a manner which does not require a new instruction/order to be issued, according to local clinical rules.

id44.description: The datetime at which the medication order was scheduled to occur.

id45.description: Administration of a dose of mediciation has been delayed but is expected to be given as soon as possible.

id54.description: Further structured details of the action, possibly specific to a pathway step.

id83.description: Details of the product dispensed, authorised or administered.

id84.description: Assigned by the manufacturer to identify the manufacturing batch of the item.

id85.description: The expiry date of the medicine administered as documented by the manufacturer.

id86.description: Additional information required to capture local content or to align with other reference models/formalisms.

id104.description: The identifier assigned with the original order.

id106.description: The proportion of the maximum allowed dose equivalent administered.

id107.description: A repeat prescription or dispense has been re-authorised.

id110.description: The medication has been recommended but no steps have been taken to initiate prescribing.

id117.description: The reason(s) why a particular dose administration did not take place, including complte omission of the dose and deferral of the dose.

id118.description: The reason(s) for amending or stopping a course of medication.

at119.description: The patient experienced an adverse reaction.

at120.description: The clinical response to the medication was inadequate.

at121.description: The course was changed because of patient preference or difficulty.

at122.description: The medication was prescribed in error.

at124.description: The medication was suspended for a temporary period only.

at125.description: The dose form/strength and or route were changed.

at126.description: The patient refused to take the medication.

at127.description: The patient is on a nil-by-mouth regime.

at130.description: The medication administration was withheld/deferred for a clinical reason.

id132.description: Details of the amount of medication supplied i.e. authorised, dispensed or administered.

id133.description: Subsitution action taken by the dispenser.

id134.description: The reason or justification for the substitution action taken.

id138.description: A  suspended medication has had its restart date or condition set.

at139.description: A medication was dispensed which is bioequivalent to that ordered.

at140.description: Although allowed by the medication order a substitute bioequvalent medication was not dispensed.

id141.description: Details of body site and delivery of the medication.

id142.description: Identification of the site of administration of the medication, vaccine or therapeutic good.

id143.description: Structured description of the site of administration  of the medication, vaccine or therapeutic good.

id144.description: The method by which the medication is to be delivered.

id145.description: Details of the medical device used to assist delivery of the medication.

at14.description: A scheduled medication has been postponed prior to any administration.

at13.description: The planned administration has been cancelled prior to any administration.

at17.description: The time to start this medication, or other starting condition, has been set.

at138.description: A  suspended medication has had its restart date or condition set.
